recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD4 對側向散射（SSC-A）點圖：84% 事件位於 CD4 陽性閘門，主要族群為 CD4 弱至中度陽性、SSC 中低，落在單核球區域，符合單核球系（monocytic）細胞擴增；CD4 單一抗原並不具系別特異性。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot of CD4 (x-axis, log) versus SSC-A (y-axis, linear), singlet-gated
Dominant population with dim-to-moderate CD4 and low-intermediate SSC (monocytic region)
Smaller CD4-negative populations with low SSC (lymphocytes) and a scattered higher-SSC CD4-negative component
Tail of cells with higher SSC and CD4 expression extending upward
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of peripheral blood singlets displays CD4 versus side scatter. The CD4-positive gate contains 84% of events, with the dominant population showing dim to moderate CD4 expression and low-to-intermediate side scatter, a pattern typical of monocytic cells, which express CD4 more weakly than helper T cells. CD4-negative events of low side scatter represent lymphocytes and other cells. CD4 alone is not lineage specific, and additional markers (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD36, HLA-DR, CD34/CD117) are required; in context, the plot supports an expanded monocytic population in acute monocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: CD4+ T-cell proliferation (e.g. Sézary syndrome, T-PLL)
ddx.vs: T cells show bright CD4 with low SSC and co-express CD3, whereas monocytic cells are CD4 dim, CD3 negative and CD64/CD14 positive.
BPDCN is CD4+ CD56+ CD123 bright TCF4+ but lacks CD14, CD64 bright and MPO/lysozyme expression.
